rationale: renders (R3, no grammar change, landed 2026-10-23): a View type's `var body: some View` names the component the type renders — the dart lane's `build`-returns-`Widget` shape (real-dart-analyzer.ts:4274), copying its return-type host discriminator and its top-level-expression-only refusal. Both halves of the trigger are structural and measured over the whole admitted population (validation/m14/fixtures/swift/m14-swift-extended-census-output.txt): 85 `var body: some View` sites over 38 files, 72 View conformances over 38 files. Tier usage_contextual, matching all four existing renders lanes.

forbidRelationships.comment: THE NON-HOST REFUSAL: a `body` property on a type that does NOT conform to View is not a rendering host (the protobuf-builder impostor shape)
THE NON-BODY REFUSAL: `var helper: some View` is not the type's rendering entry point; only `body` is
an argument-position construction is never the rendered component — the dart 'not the returned expression' refusal
a child of the rendered tree is not what the body renders
THE SCALAR REFUSAL: a member whose declared type is not `some View` (here `Int`) is never a rendered component — the target surface is view TYPES the body's top-level call names, not property types
THE FUNCTION REFUSAL: `func makeView() -> some View` is not the type's rendering entry point; only the `body` PROPERTY is the structural render site
THE GENERIC NON-HOST REFUSAL: a generic container that does not conform to View is not a rendering host, whatever its `body` property says
